sustainable solutions are delivered.<\/p><p>You act as the central interface between Logistics, IT and implementation partners and represent our clients\u2019 business interests clearly and consistently.<\/p><p><strong>Your Responsibilities<\/strong><\/p><ul><li>You are responsible for the overall functional management of SAP EWM projects for our clients, including implementation, requirements and success criteria for warehouse and intralogistics processes and ensure that these are implemented consistently by IT and implementation partners.<\/li><li>You coordinate and lead functional key users, process owners and, where applicable, internal EWM experts on the client side and support the development of a strong and reliable business team around EWM.<\/li><li>You manage external SAP implementation partners, developers and technical service providers from a functional perspective: you define requirements, priorities and acceptance criteria and monitor the quality of delivery.<\/li><li>You are responsible for functional test management, including test design, test cases, UAT and sign-off, as well as business-side cutover planning and the preparation and support of go-live and the hypercare phase.<\/li><li>You establish clear project governance from a business perspective, including decision-making processes, escalation paths, status reporting to Logistics management and the steering committee, as well as issue and change management.<\/li><li>You drive change communication, training and employee enablement on the client side and ensure that a capable and sustainable business organization is in place after project completion.<\/li><\/ul><\/p><br><strong>Who you are<\/strong><p><p>You combine strong logistics and process expertise with a good As AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you are the person who bridges that gap: turning strategic ambition into lasting organizational change.<\/span><p style=\"line-height:1.38;text-align:justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;\"><span style=\"font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Roboto, sans-serif;color:#212529;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;text-decoration:none;\">Merantix Momentum is developing the next generation of impact-driven AI. As a Berlin-based startup, we are driving enterprise AI transformations across industries by building and deploying B2B solutions, orchestrating scaled, AI-native operations. We work across several domains including automotive, manufacturing, healthcare, and others, transforming businesses through ML using our core expertise in state-of-the-art machine learning. Our start-up DNA defines the way we drive rapid value creation with a humble, diverse, and hungry team.<\/span><\/p><\/p><br><strong>Your role<\/strong><p><p style=\"line-height:1.38;text-align:justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 10pt 0pt;\"><span style=\"font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Roboto, sans-serif;color:#212529;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;text-decoration:none;\">As an AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you bring deep domain and consulting experience to lead clients through end-to-end AI transformation, from identifying strategic opportunities to driving organizational and technical change at scale. You are equally comfortable leading a focused 6-week engagement with a 500-person Mittelstand manufacturer as well as a multi-phase transformation with a large enterprise. You act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives.<\/span><\/p><p style=\"line-height:1.38;text-align:justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 10pt 0pt;\"><span style=\"font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Roboto, sans-serif;color:#212529;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;text-decoration:none;\">You support our business growth by contributing to lead conversion, proposal writing, and pre-sales activities with entrepreneurial energy. With a strong presence and an opinionated point of view, you represent Merantix Momentum\u2019s AI Transformation perspective externally through expert discussions, LinkedIn content, and thought leadership in our core verticals.<\/span><\/p><p style=\"line-height:1.38;text-align:justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;padding:0pt 0pt 10pt 0pt;\"><span style=\"font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Roboto, sans-serif;color:#212529;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;text-decoration:none;\">Internally, you contribute to the continuous development of our AI Transformation offering by evolving expertise, methods, and tools, leading by example with a fast-paced, can-do attitude and high degree of self-assurance. You will support the DACH region covering majors accounts, acting as the primary specialist to drive revenue growth within Zero Trust Networking suite of products (Cloud\/Branch Connector, AirGap, IoT). You will lead the charge in demonstrating the power of cloud transformation to cement our position as a global leader in cloud security.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do (Role Expectations)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the primary specialist for customers, partners, and internal teams to drive revenue growth across the Zero Trust Branch product portfolio&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with domain-expert solution engineers to capture customer requirements and craft compelling value propositions that close complex business deals&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the regional quota and territory achievement by building and implementing account-based strategies to land and expand the Zero Trust Branch product solutions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate synergistically with primary sales teams and leadership to ensure a unified and effective Zscaler presence in the market&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Engage stakeholders across the organization, selling effectively to both C-suite executives and technical practitioners&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are (Success Profile)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You thrive in ambiguity. You&#39;re comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You act like an owner. As one of the industry\u2019s longest-standing global macro and trend-following managers, Graham remains committed to innovation, evolving its strategies through a robust investment, technology, and operational infrastructure. Graham invests significant proprietary capital alongside its clients \u2013 including global institutions, endowments, foundations, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, investment management advisors, and qualified individual investors \u2013 reinforcing alignment of interests across all strategies.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The foundation of Graham\u2019s sustainability and success is the experience and contributions of its people. We envision, design, prototype and implement the processes that feed Quantitative Research and Discretionary Trading teams as well as the broader firm. We are passionate about what we do and welcome every opportunity to prove it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Data Science department straddles traditional Data Science and Engineering roles as well as the application of Machine Learning &amp;amp; AI. We work closely with Quant Researchers, Portfolio Managers, Operations and Execution to continuously improve upon our offering. Every day we work to transform our business through data, technology, and the insights we provide our stakeholders.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Graham Capital, our systems feed live models around the clock, span billions of market data ticks, an ever-increasing corpus of news and other texts as well as a broad spectrum of financial and alternative data. Our objective is to support the research process by providing our stakeholders with all the right pieces to succeed in their jobs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be part of a growing team within Data Science. You will work closely with other areas such as Technology, Quantitative Research and Portfolio Manager groups as well as Risk and Operations to learn about problems they face with respect to data and ultimately develop cutting edge solutions. Your focus will be to dive deep into multiple data sets to understand relationships, develop time series, forecasting models, and support quant strategies, and provide new insights and leverage state-of-the-art machine learning and advanced statistical methods to produce the best data sources for the fund.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;s&gt; You will also have a proactive approach to business partnering, advising and supporting managers through employee relations matters and workforce planning. You will be a trusted confidante to Schonfeld\u2019s leadership team and be that bridge between the management and the&amp;nbsp;employees, ensuring effective communication and fostering a positive work&amp;nbsp;environment.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt; advice.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with strategy heads, functional heads and senior leadership on organizational design, workforce planning and people strategy.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Leverage people analytics to spot trends, quantify risk, and present actionable insights that influence people strategy&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive engagement programs that meaningfully elevate the employee experience and culture&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Oversee the EMEA benefits and payroll activities for the region.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide guidance on regional compensation framework, including salary, bonus and deferred compensation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own key Human Resources activities; which may include but not limited to performance improvement plans, headcount analysis &amp;amp; reporting, end to end process management of leavers, and talent management activities, including succession planning.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with local partners to coordinate internal employee mobility (including international transfers, visas, tax matters) and to align \/ streamline internal processes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Advise on complex employee relations matters, including employment contracts, restrictive covenants, and regulatory requirements&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure HR data integrity and accuracy by working closely with HRIS and key systems to streamline reporting processes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure global policy alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;What you\u2019ll bring&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;10+ years of HCM \/ HR experience, with significant time spent in financial services \u2013 hedge fund, asset management or investment banking strongly preferred.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Regional expertise on EMEA employment practice and working knowledge of UK employment legislation and UAE Labor Law&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated experience leading an HCM function or team while remaining hands-on in a lean, fast-moving environment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong commercial acumen and the ability to operate credibly alongside senior investment and business partners.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong HR business partner experience within financial services with a focus on optimizing talent and building culture&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to work in a global business, building strong, effective and trusted relationships in multiple geographies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic and complex working&amp;nbsp;environment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to constructively challenge and influence senior business leaders&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Expertise partnering with senior business leaders on shaping their organizational strategy and goals&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong written and verbal communication skills; exceptional judgement, discretion and EQ; strong analytical skills and a data-focused mindset&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to use HR reporting &amp;amp; analytics to generate insights and present these findings to the business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Who we are&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt; &amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;Schonfeld Strategic Advisors is a global multi-strategy, multi-manager investment platform that harnesses the transformative power of people to perform in all market environments. Our dynamic culture inspires better outcomes for our team, our investors, and our partners. We aim to consistently deliver risk-adjusted returns, with people driving performance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We specialize in four core strategies: Quantitative Trading, Fundamental Equity, Tactical Trading, and Discretionary Macro &amp;amp; Fixed Income. We capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets, drawing from a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure, and risk analytics.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We invest through internal portfolio managers and external partner funds, pursuing alignment among investors, investment professionals, and the firm. Our footprint spans 7 countries and 19 offices.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Our Culture&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt; &lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;Talent is our strategy. We believe our success is because of our people, so putting our talent above all else is our top priority. We are teamwork-oriented, and collaborative, and encourage ideas\u2014at all levels\u2014to be shared. Operating with a high degree of autonomy; you&#39;ll manage complex, high-value deals end-to-end, drive forecast accuracy, and actively shape how we go to market. This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic influence: you&#39;ll be as comfortable building a Looker report as you are leading a high-stakes negotiation, and as effective with Finance and Product as you are in front of a customer.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own and grow a portfolio of key accounts, consistently exceeding revenue targets and carrying above-average quota.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain accurate pipeline and revenue forecasts, surfacing risks proactively and identifying in-quarter opportunities to accelerate attainment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead complex, high-value negotiations; adapting style to different stakeholders and closing with minimal concessions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and tailor compelling value propositions, running multi-channel outreach to fill and advance pipeline efficiently.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage multiple concurrent work-streams with clear ownership, balancing scope, time, and quality with minimal oversight.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to deliver solutions and influence roadmap priorities based on customer feedback.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Analyse multi-dimensional data in Looker, AI and Google Sheets to surface actionable insights and build compelling, decision-driving narratives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coach junior team members and contribute to a culture of proactive, well-received feedback.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in digital advertising, account management, or consultative sales; preferably within mobile or programmatic ad-tech.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong forecasting discipline and pipeline management skills, with experience running high-value deals from prospecting through close.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Skilled negotiator who adapts approach intuitively and is comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficient in Looker, AI and Google Sheets, with the ability to analyse complex data sets and build clear, impactful visualisations independently.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent cross-functional collaborator, with experience engaging Product, Finance, and Marketing beyond immediate deal needs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and the ability to give and receive feedback constructively.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor&#39;s degree; The platform generates and tests hypotheses at superhuman scale, and you ensure that process translates into real, high-quality compounds that advance toward the clinic.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role leans heavily into the AI and computational side of our workflow: you will be accountable for throughput, quality, and the operational health of the discovery engine, working hand-in-hand with AI scientists, computational chemists, and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks, close feedback loops, and continuously improve how the platform performs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Be Building&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own small molecule discovery programs against assigned targets, from hit identification through lead optimization and candidate nomination.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the accountable leader for discovery output setting and hitting timelines, quality benchmarks, and throughput targets across active programs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Operate as the primary interface between the autonomous science platform and drug discovery decision-making, ensuring that what the platform produces meets the bar for potency, selectivity, ADMET properties, and developability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate daily with AI\/ML, robotics, and software engineering teams to close the loop between computational predictions and experimental results, driving continuous improvement of the platform&#39;s predictive accuracy and experimental efficiency.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Architect the components of each discovery program end to end, specifying the required assays, building or sourcing the right capabilities, and managing the scientific staff needed to execute. Define and enforce the quality standards, assay cascades, and decision criteria that govern how compounds progress through the pipeline.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Facilitate relationships with CROs and external partners for specialized studies (e.g., in vivo pharmacology, safety pharmacology, DMPK) that sit outside the automated platform.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide drug discovery expertise to Lila&#39;s product team for commercial partnerships, translating platform capabilities into credible value propositions for pharma and biotech collaborators.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Need to Succeed&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ph.D. in medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, or a closely related discipline.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;12+ years of experience in small molecule drug discovery from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side with at least 5 years in a senior role closely involved in advancing compounds from hit-to-lead through candidate selection.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated involvement in programs that delivered clinical candidates, with enough proximity to compound progression decisions to own them whether from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep fluency in medicinal chemistry principles, you may not have practiced bench medchem, but you understand SAR, synthetic tractability, and the multiparameter tradeoffs at the core of lead optimization (potency, selectivity, ADMET, PK, safety) well enough to guide them or define systematic decision frameworks for them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Operational mindset, experience running discovery programs with clear metrics, milestones, and accountability structures, and a comfort level with managing throughput and efficiency alongside scientific quality.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong working knowledge of ADMET, DMPK, and the data packages required to advance a candidate to IND-enabling studies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluency with AI\/ML-driven molecular design approaches (generative chemistry, molecular property prediction, free energy methods, active learning) and the practical judgment to know when computational output is actionable and when it needs experimental validation. You don\u2019t need to build models, but you must be a credible, hands-on collaborator with the scientists who do.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Effective communicator who can translate complex scientific and operational status into clear updates for leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bonus Points For&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Direct experience with automated, high-throughput, or closed-loop discovery environments (e.g., self-driving labs, robotic synthesis and screening platforms), you&#39;ve seen what it takes to make these systems produce real drug discovery output, not just proof-of-concept demos.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience applying computational chemistry or cheminformatics in a hands-on capacity, not just consuming model outputs, but contributing to how molecular design hypotheses are generated, scored, and prioritized.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building or scaling a discovery operation from early stage, standing up assay cascades, workflows, team structures, and vendor relationships without inheriting a mature infrastructure.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background across multiple therapeutic areas, giving you breadth in target biology and the flexibility to work across a diverse portfolio.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Process-oriented thinking: you instinctively look for ways to measure, standardize, and improve how work gets done, without letting process become bureaucracy.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-pay-transparency&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;pay-input&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;description&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Compensation&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. At Faire, we&#39;re using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town \u2014 we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. You bring a strong commercial mindset, comfortable operating at the most senior levels of an organisation, and you use AI, data, and sharp instincts to outperform. German and English bilingual fluency is mandatory: you will lead the full sales cycle natively in German, with no reliance on translation or a local partner to close.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are genuinely exciting.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You\u2019re excited about this opportunity because\u2026&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have been top of the leaderboard way&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Stay resilient and input-focused when performance is challenging; model the standard for the team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Be the expert on the DACH market&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be solution-oriented to common objections and DACH-specific blockers, including local business norms, procurement processes, and regulatory considerations. recoverable, prepayments and committed spend - and feed these positions into the group management balance sheet dashboard on an automated, near-real-time basis.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><em>Project lifecycle and business partnering<\/em><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Cradle to completion: support projects through their With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients\u2019 own research content. &lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p style=&quot;text-align: justify;&quot;&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&amp;amp;P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About Expert Insights:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense\u2019s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp; &lt;\/span&gt;delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what\u2019s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense\u2019s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market\u2019s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Team:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role:&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Sector Lead (Energy &amp;amp; Industrials) on our Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research for E&amp;amp;I you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm\u2019s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research\u2019s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You\u2019ll Do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with&lt;span class=&quot;Apple-converted-space&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp; Dans un monde o\u00f9 les m\u00e9dias sont omnipr\u00e9sents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour d\u00e9velopper les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance in\u00e9gal\u00e9e \u00e0 nos clients. Pour plus d&#39;informations, visitez &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.wppmedia.com\/&quot;&gt;wppmedia.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C&#39;est gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 cette synergie que nous parvenons \u00e0 cr\u00e9er des exp\u00e9riences v\u00e9ritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos \u00e9quipes internes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour r\u00e9ussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d&#39;incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;\u00catre Extraordinaire&lt;\/strong&gt; en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une cr\u00e9ativit\u00e9 v\u00e9ritablement transformationnelle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cr\u00e9er un environnement Ouvert&lt;\/strong&gt; en trouvant l&#39;\u00e9quilibre parfait entre l&#39;\u00e9panouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fond\u00e9 sur une confiance mutuelle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Diriger avec Optimisme&lt;\/strong&gt; en stimulant activement la croissance et le d\u00e9veloppement pour mobiliser l&#39;ensemble de notre organisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;R\u00f4le et missions :&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Contexte :&lt;\/strong&gt; &lt;br&gt;Vous int\u00e9grez le p\u00f4le Planning m\u00e9dia d&#39;une Business Unit d\u00e9di\u00e9e \u00e0 des comptes prestigieux dans l\u2019univers du luxe. &lt;br&gt;Au sein d&#39;une \u00e9quipe dynamique, vous assurez la gestion et la coordination quotidienne des campagnes m\u00e9dias. Ce poste offre un contact direct et r\u00e9gulier avec des maisons de luxe de premier plan ainsi qu&#39;une dimension internationale affirm\u00e9e.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Mission :&lt;\/strong&gt; Au quotidien, vous accompagnez les \u00e9quipes clients dans la construction, le suivi et la mise en \u0153uvre de leurs strat\u00e9gies m\u00e9dia plurim\u00e9dia, en garantissant une excellence op\u00e9rationnelle et une communication fluide.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Vos principales missions seront :&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Relation Client &amp;amp; Strat\u00e9gie M\u00e9dia :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assurer le suivi au quotidien des demandes clients et la prise de briefs pour les maisons attribu\u00e9es.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participer activement \u00e0 l&#39;\u00e9laboration des recommandations et plans m\u00e9dias int\u00e9gr\u00e9s en collaboration avec vos managers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Pr\u00e9parer et pr\u00e9senter les recommandations m\u00e9dias aux interlocuteurs clients avec clart\u00e9 et conviction, en fran\u00e7ais comme en anglais.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Analyse &amp;amp; Reporting :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;R\u00e9aliser des analyses concurrentielles qualitatives et quantitatives (suivi des investissements m\u00e9dia et des strat\u00e9gies de communication) gr\u00e2ce aux outils du march\u00e9.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assurer le suivi op\u00e9rationnel des campagnes, leur optimisation et la production des reportings en coordination avec les \u00e9quipes d&#39;activation sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9es.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\u00c9laborer les bilans de campagne et d\u00e9gager les enseignements cl\u00e9s.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Coordination &amp;amp; Op\u00e9rations :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assurer la coordination internationale avec nos agences locales et centraliser les \u00e9changes pour les clients globaux.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Travailler en synergie avec les experts m\u00e9dia internes (Digital, Multi-screen, Affichage, Search) et les r\u00e9gies publicitaires.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Gestion Financi\u00e8re &amp;amp; Hygi\u00e8ne de Compte :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cr\u00e9er les devis clients, effectuer le suivi de la facturation et v\u00e9rifier les bons de commande sous Media Manager.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Garantir le respect des process financiers et la parfaite tenue administrative des dossiers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Profil Recherch\u00e9 :&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Formation &amp;amp; Exp\u00e9rience :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Dipl\u00f4m\u00e9(e) d&#39;un Bac+4\/5 (\u00c9cole de Commerce, Universit\u00e9 ou \u00c9cole de Communication).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Profil junior avec une premi\u00e8re exp\u00e9rience r\u00e9ussie (stage, alternance ou premier emploi) en agence m\u00e9dia ou chez l&#39;annonceur.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une premi\u00e8re exp\u00e9rience ou un fort int\u00e9r\u00eat pour le secteur du luxe est appr\u00e9ci\u00e9, mais c&#39;est avant tout l&#39;app\u00e9tence, le savoir-\u00eatre et la rigueur m\u00e9dia qui feront la diff\u00e9rence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Langues (Indispensable) :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bilingue Fran\u00e7ais &amp;amp; Anglais&lt;\/strong&gt; :&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Comp\u00e9tences techniques &amp;amp; Qualit\u00e9s :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellente ma\u00eetrise du Pack Office (particuli\u00e8rement &lt;strong&gt;Excel&lt;\/strong&gt; pour la manipulation de donn\u00e9es chiffr\u00e9es et &lt;strong&gt;PowerPoint&lt;\/strong&gt; pour les pr\u00e9sentations).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bonne culture m\u00e9dia et compr\u00e9hension g\u00e9n\u00e9rale des diff\u00e9rents leviers (Digital, TV, Affichage, Social, Search).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Rigueur op\u00e9rationnelle, pr\u00e9cision et aisance avec les chiffres.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Savoir-\u00eatre &amp;amp; \u00c9ducation&lt;\/strong&gt; : Excellente pr\u00e9sentation, sens du d\u00e9tail, \u00e9coute et ma\u00eetrise des codes d&#39;un univers haut de gamme et feutr\u00e9.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Esprit d&#39;\u00e9quipe &amp;amp; Cette d\u00e9marche s&#39;accompagne d&#39;une vision responsable dans nos strat\u00e9gies d&#39;investissement m\u00e9diatique, refl\u00e9tant ainsi notre double priorit\u00e9 : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un acc\u00e8s privil\u00e9gi\u00e9 aux r\u00e9seaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de d\u00e9velopper leurs passions, d&#39;\u00e9tendre leur r\u00e9seau professionnel et de rester \u00e0 la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicit\u00e9.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous disposons de ressources vastes et vari\u00e9es au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l&#39;inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les r\u00e9ussites et expertises des \u00e9quipes sont r\u00e9guli\u00e8rement mises en lumi\u00e8re lors d&#39;\u00e9v\u00e9nements f\u00e9d\u00e9rateurs qui ponctuent \u00e9galement les moments cl\u00e9s de l&#39;ann\u00e9e, renfor\u00e7ant ainsi notre culture d&#39;entreprise collaborative et diversifi\u00e9e.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nos avantages comprennent :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;T\u00e9l\u00e9travail :&lt;\/strong&gt; jusqu&#39;\u00e0 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines compl\u00e8tes \u00e0 prendre en deux fois dans l\u2019ann\u00e9e.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cong\u00e9s offerts :&lt;\/strong&gt; 2 jours de repos suppl\u00e9mentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentec\u00f4te.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Anciennet\u00e9 :&lt;\/strong&gt; Jours de cong\u00e9 additionnels par palier de 5 ans d\u2019anciennet\u00e9.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Sant\u00e9 &amp;amp; \u00c9quit\u00e9 :&lt;\/strong&gt; 5 jours de t\u00e9l\u00e9travail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d\u2019endom\u00e9triose.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Politique handicap :&lt;\/strong&gt; 3 jours d&#39;absence autoris\u00e9s pay\u00e9s par an, acc\u00e8s \u00e0 des Ch\u00e8ques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements sp\u00e9cifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Engagement soci\u00e9tal :&lt;\/strong&gt; Missions solidaires possibles via le programme &lt;em&gt;We care and we act&lt;\/em&gt;.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Tools :&lt;\/strong&gt; Acc\u00e8s \u00e0 des outils performants et \u00e0 la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Process de recrutement :&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous nous engageons \u00e0 rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et \u00e0 maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Entretien avec l\u2019\u00e9quipe Recrutement :&lt;\/strong&gt; Un premier entretien t\u00e9l\u00e9phonique ou par vid\u00e9oconf\u00e9rence avec l\u2019\u00e9quipe Talent pour aborder votre parcours et \u00e9changer sur le poste.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Entretien op\u00e9rationnel :&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;Un entretien avec le Manager pour \u00e9valuer l&#39;ad\u00e9quation de vos comp\u00e9tences et de votre profil.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;\u00c9tude de cas (Business Case) :&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;Une \u00e9tude de cas technique vous sera propos\u00e9e apr\u00e8s l&#39;entretien op\u00e9rationnel afin d\u2019\u00e9valuer vos comp\u00e9tences techniques li\u00e9es au poste.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Entretien Physique &amp;amp; Restitution du Business Case :&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;Un entretien physique obligatoire, lors duquel vous pr\u00e9senterez votre Business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WPP Media garantit l&#39;\u00e9galit\u00e9 des chances et consid\u00e8re tous les candidats sans discrimination ni consid\u00e9ration de caract\u00e9ristiques particuli\u00e8res. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships \u2013 all united by our\u202fpioneering\u202fagentic marketing platform, WPP Open \u2013 we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.\u202f&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WPP Media is WPP&#39;s AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For more information, visit &lt;a href=&quot;wppmedia.com&quot;&gt;wppmedia.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Dans un souci de clart\u00e9 et d\u2019accessibilit\u00e9, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l\u2019\u00e9criture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engag\u00e9 en faveur de la diversit\u00e9 : nous valorisons l&#39;inclusion et l&#39;\u00e9galit\u00e9, en consid\u00e9rant tous les candidats sans distinction d&#39;identit\u00e9 de genre, d&#39;origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont \u00e9galement ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;A propos de WPP Media :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;Nous r\u00e9unissons une intelligence m\u00e9dia de pointe, une cr\u00e9ativit\u00e9 de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle g\u00e9n\u00e9ration, des solutions pour transformer le marketing \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e8re de l\u2019IA et un conseil strat\u00e9gique d\u2019expert au sein d\u2019une seule compagnie.&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;Propuls\u00e9s par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous d\u00e9ployons l\u2019IA \u00e0 grande \u00e9chelle pour aider nos clients \u00e0 naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et \u00e0 optimiser leurs investissements marketing.&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;Pour plus d\u2019informations, visitez\u202f&lt;a href=&quot;http:\/\/www.wpp.com\/&quot;&gt;www.wpp.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;WPP Media est le collectif m\u00e9dia global de WPP. Dans un monde o\u00f9 les m\u00e9dias sont omnipr\u00e9sents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour d\u00e9velopper les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance in\u00e9gal\u00e9e \u00e0 nos clients.&amp;nbsp;Pour plus d&#39;informations, visitez &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.wppmedia.com\/&quot;&gt;wppmedia.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C&#39;est gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 cette synergie que nous parvenons \u00e0 cr\u00e9er des exp\u00e9riences v\u00e9ritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos \u00e9quipes internes. Pour r\u00e9ussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d&#39;incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\u00catre &lt;strong&gt;Extraordinaire&lt;\/strong&gt; en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une cr\u00e9ativit\u00e9 v\u00e9ritablement transformationnelle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cr\u00e9er un environnement &lt;strong&gt;Ouvert&lt;\/strong&gt; en trouvant l&#39;\u00e9quilibre parfait entre l&#39;\u00e9panouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fond\u00e9 sur une confiance mutuelle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Diriger avec &lt;strong&gt;Optimisme&lt;\/strong&gt; en stimulant activement la croissance et le d\u00e9veloppement pour mobiliser l&#39;ensemble de notre organisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Contexte :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Vous rejoignez WPP Media Commerce, le p\u00f4le d&#39;expertise d\u00e9di\u00e9 \u00e0 la croissance omnicanale des clients du groupe. Dans un march\u00e9 en pleine effervescence, vous int\u00e9grerez une \u00e9quipe dynamique au c\u0153ur des strat\u00e9gies eCommerce. &lt;br&gt;Le poste sera initialement d\u00e9di\u00e9 \u00e0 un portefeuille de marques embl\u00e9matiques d&#39;un&amp;nbsp;leader mondial de l&#39;agroalimentaire et des biens de consommation&amp;nbsp;(caf\u00e9, nutrition animale, etc.), et offre des perspectives d&#39;\u00e9volution vers d&#39;autres clients d&#39;envergure.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Missions :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Gestion de Campagnes de A \u00e0 Z :&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;G\u00e9rer le d\u00e9ploiement op\u00e9rationnel des campagnes sur les plateformes eRetail (Amazon, Criteo, etc.). &lt;br&gt;Cela inclut le param\u00e9trage pr\u00e9cis, le suivi quotidien des performances et l&#39;optimisation en continu pour d\u00e9passer les objectifs de ROAS et de conversion. Vous assurerez \u00e9galement la gestion financi\u00e8re, du devis \u00e0 la facturation.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Conseil &amp;amp; Partenariat Strat\u00e9gique :&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance pour vos clients, en traduisant leurs objectifs business en strat\u00e9gies eRetail Media efficaces. &lt;br&gt;Vous d\u00e9velopperez et pr\u00e9senterez des recommandations claires (plan d&#39;activation, allocation budg\u00e9taire, bilans de campagne) et cultiverez une relation solide avec les clients comme avec les r\u00e9gies partenaires.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Analyse &amp;amp; Veille Active :&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;Plonger dans les donn\u00e9es de performance (m\u00e9dia et retail) pour en extraire des insights pertinents. &lt;br&gt;Vous construirez des reportings r\u00e9guliers et des bilans complets qui racontent l&#39;histoire de vos campagnes et d\u00e9montrent leur valeur. &lt;br&gt;Proactif, vous assurerez une veille constante sur les innovations du march\u00e9 pour identifier de nouvelles opportunit\u00e9s de croissance pour vos clients.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Profil recherch\u00e9 :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Votre Exp\u00e9rience :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Vous justifiez d&#39;une premi\u00e8re exp\u00e9rience r\u00e9ussie (stage, alternance ou premier emploi) en agence m\u00e9dia ou chez l&#39;annonceur, dans le domaine de la publicit\u00e9 digitale.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Vous \u00eates dipl\u00f4m\u00e9(e) d&#39;une formation Bac+4\/5 (\u00c9cole de Commerce, de Communication ou \u00e9quivalent).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Vous nourrissez un fort int\u00e9r\u00eat pour l&#39;univers des m\u00e9dias, du e-commerce et\/ou du retail.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Vos Comp\u00e9tences Techniques :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Vous ma\u00eetrisez la suite Office, en particulier Excel (les TCD n&#39;ont pas de secret pour vous) et PowerPoint pour des pr\u00e9sentations claires et impactantes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une connaissance des plateformes eRetail Media (Amazon, Criteo, Citrus, Unlimitail...) est un v\u00e9ritable atout.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;La familiarit\u00e9 avec des outils de trading eRetail Media ou d\u2019analyse retail (Pacvue, Skai, Dataimpact, Datagram, \u2026) serait un plus appr\u00e9ci\u00e9&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Votre niveau d&#39;anglais est op\u00e9rationnel (B2), vous permettant d&#39;\u00e9changer avec des \u00e9quipes internationales.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Vos Qualit\u00e9s Humaines pour R\u00e9ussir :&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Dot\u00e9(e) d&#39;un excellent esprit d&#39;analyse, vous aimez faire parler les chiffres pour en tirer des conclusions pertinentes et actionnables.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Votre rigueur, votre sens de l&#39;organisation et votre proactivit\u00e9 sont vos meilleurs alli\u00e9s pour g\u00e9rer plusieurs projets en parall\u00e8le avec autonomie.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communicant(e), vous savez pr\u00e9senter vos id\u00e9es avec clart\u00e9 et conviction, et vous \u00e9panouissez dans le travail d&#39;\u00e9quipe et la co-construction.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Curieux(se) et dynamique, vous \u00eates en veille constante sur un secteur en perp\u00e9tuelle \u00e9volution.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;La vie chez WPP Media et ses These are milestones, not the finish line.&nbsp;<br><br>With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product\u2013market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.<br><br>This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.<br><br>What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world\u2019s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we\u2019ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who\u2019ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.<br><br>At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.<\/p><h3><strong>Mission <\/strong><\/h3><p>As a <strong>Lead Product Manager <\/strong>on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.<\/p><p>Your main responsibilities will include:<\/p><ul><li><strong>Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles: <\/strong>core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.<\/li><li><strong>Own LiveOps end-to-end.<\/strong> You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.<\/li><li><strong>Lead your team.<\/strong> You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.<\/li><li><strong>Oversee the monetization model.<\/strong> Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.<\/li><li><strong>Drive growth, in partnership with UA.<\/strong> You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.<\/li><li><strong>Cross-functional excellence.<\/strong> You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.<\/li><li><strong>Set the bar.<\/strong> Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.<\/li><li><strong>Stay hands-on when it counts.<\/strong> This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.<\/li><\/ul><p><\/p><p>This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.<\/p><p><strong>Requirements<\/strong><\/p><p>We are looking for someone with <strong>several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG,<\/strong> with genuine end-to-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. We\u2019re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Your experience in omics will allow you to contribute to the building of our AI Scientist, an agentic system designed to navigate the complexities of target and drug discovery.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">\u00a0<\/p><h1>In particular, you will:<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Contribute analyses to projects aiming to discover novel drug targets, biomarkers and disease subtypes through reverse translation based on multi-omics patient or pre-clinical data including: genomic, transcriptomic (spatial, single-cell, bulk), proteomic, and others.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">analyze biomedical datasets using classical or novel omics methods and machine \/ deep learning algorithms<\/p><\/li><li><p Le digital et l&#39;IA sont les moteurs de notre ambition 2026-2030 pour rendre le sport durablement accessible. Et l&#39;accessibilit\u00e9 commence par le bon prix : juste, fiable et disponible partout, \u00e0 chaque instant.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Chaque jour, dans plus de 2 000 magasins et plus de 50 pays, des millions de prix changent. Une erreur, c&#39;est un client mal servi, un magasin en difficult\u00e9, de la confiance perdue. Notre r\u00f4le : identifier et transmettre le bon prix, au bon moment, sans erreur, partout dans le monde.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour y parvenir, 2 produits critiques traitent en moyenne 7 millions d&#39;\u00e9v\u00e9nements par jour, avec des pics \u00e0 plusieurs dizaines de millions. Ils tournent 24\/7 avec un SLA sup\u00e9rieur \u00e0 99,9 % et un objectif simple : ne perdre aucun \u00e9v\u00e9nement. Autour d&#39;eux, 4 autres produits exploitent les donn\u00e9es de vente et proposent des leviers de dynamisme commercial aux magasins. Une plateforme event-driven qui scale sous la charge, et une \u00e9quipe passionn\u00e9e qui la fait \u00e9voluer en continu, sans jamais transiger sur la qualit\u00e9. Notre prochain cap : repousser nos limites en performance, en r\u00e9silience et en architecture. Pour y parvenir, la data est au c\u0153ur de notre strat\u00e9gie, guidant chaque d\u00e9cision, de la conception du produit \u00e0 l&#39;exp\u00e9rience client. Notre d\u00e9fi ? La rendre gouvern\u00e9e, s\u00fbre et exploitable. Tu rejoindras le Data &amp;amp; AI Governance Center of Expertise (CoE), une \u00e9quipe dynamique de passionn\u00e9\u00b7es, pour transformer notre patrimoine de donn\u00e9es brutes en un actif certifi\u00e9, auditable et actionnable, garantissant ainsi l\u2019excellence de nos donn\u00e9es et notre transition vers l&#39;IA.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;En tant que &lt;strong&gt;Senior Data Steward&lt;\/strong&gt;, tu seras un r\u00e9f\u00e9rent cl\u00e9 en Gouvernance des donn\u00e9es pour les membres de la communaut\u00e9 f\u00e9d\u00e9r\u00e9e. Tu joueras un r\u00f4le pivot dans la d\u00e9finition, le d\u00e9ploiement et l\u2019am\u00e9lioration continue des standards de gouvernance, avec un focus sur les sujets de Data Knowledge et\/ou Data Quality.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Ton temps sera partag\u00e9 entre :&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;L&#39;acc\u00e9l\u00e9ration de la feuille de route centrale du CoE Data Governance&lt;\/strong&gt; : d\u00e9finition des standards strat\u00e9giques (Data Governance by Design, r\u00e9f\u00e9rencement des exigences de qualit\u00e9 m\u00e9tier, pilotage centralis\u00e9 de la qualit\u00e9 des donn\u00e9es, int\u00e9gration des exigences de gouvernance dans le projet Data Contract de la Data Platform, et d\u00e9veloppement du Data Knowledge \/ Context Layer, etc.).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;L&#39;accompagnement d&#39;une Digital Unit \/ Domaine M\u00e9tier&lt;\/strong&gt; (Supply Chain, Commerce, Digital Sports ou Corporate Operations) et d&#39;\u00e9quipes Pays : piloter la pratique de Data Stewardship, accompagner la mont\u00e9e en maturit\u00e9, co-d\u00e9finir et piloter la trajectoire des OKR strat\u00e9giques (ex: 95% des donn\u00e9es critiques respectant leur seuil de qualit\u00e9) et animer la communaut\u00e9.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;TES RESPONSABILIT\u00c9S&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Tu vas &lt;strong&gt;pousser&lt;\/strong&gt; l&#39;organisation vers l&#39;excellence dans l&#39;ex\u00e9cution de la gouvernance et de la qualit\u00e9 des donn\u00e9es par tous les moyens n\u00e9cessaires, notamment :&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;D\u00e9finir et faire \u00e9voluer le cadre de Data Governance&lt;\/strong&gt; :&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Unified Trust &amp;amp; DQ Metrics Store&lt;\/strong&gt; : Participer \u00e0 la structuration du Data Quality Metrics Store pour offrir une vision unifi\u00e9e et transparente de la sant\u00e9 des donn\u00e9es.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Gouvernance &amp;amp; Data Contracts&lt;\/strong&gt; : Collaborer \u00e9troitement avec l&#39;\u00e9quipe Data Platform pour veiller \u00e0 ce que les exigences de gouvernance, de s\u00e9curit\u00e9\/conformit\u00e9 (classification, PII) et de qualit\u00e9 soient nativement int\u00e9gr\u00e9es dans le projet Data Contract (&lt;em&gt;&quot;Define once, apply everywhere&quot;&lt;\/em&gt;).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Data Knowledge &amp;amp; Context Layer&lt;\/strong&gt; : Structurer la connaissance technico-fonctionnelle dans le catalogue de donn\u00e9es (Collibra) et promouvoir la couche de contexte (&lt;em&gt;Context Layer&lt;\/em&gt;) pour faciliter la d\u00e9couvrabilit\u00e9 et le lignage des donn\u00e9es.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Shift-Left &amp;amp; Rem\u00e9diation&lt;\/strong&gt; : D\u00e9ployer le mod\u00e8le de responsabilit\u00e9 partag\u00e9e avec les producteurs de donn\u00e9es (&lt;em&gt;Quality by Design&lt;\/em&gt;) et standardiser le suivi des plans de rem\u00e9diation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Soutenir une Digital Unit \/ Domaine &lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Diriger et accompagner la pratique fonctionnelle et technique du Data Stewardship au sein d&#39;une verticale d\u00e9di\u00e9e.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;R\u00e9aliser des formations techniques et m\u00e9thodologiques aupr\u00e8s des Data Stewards, Data Owners et producteurs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\u00c9valuer la maturit\u00e9 Data Governance du domaine et piloter les trajectoires vers la certification des actifs critiques.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Apporter un support au quotidien et participer au recrutement des futurs co\u00e9quipiers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribuer \u00e0 d\u00e9finir les standards d&#39;excellence m\u00e9tier et \u00e9valuer le niveau d&#39;expertise lors des recrutements de la fili\u00e8re Data Governance au sein des domaines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Animer et faire grandir la communaut\u00e9 des Data stewards :&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;En tant qu&#39;expert r\u00e9f\u00e9rent, mentorer et coacher les Data Stewards moins exp\u00e9riment\u00e9s (Level 1 &amp;amp; Sur le campus de Nantes, les recherches sont focalis\u00e9es sur l\u2019analyse des transformations des organisations et des m\u00e9tiers dans des syst\u00e8mes sociotechniques. Trois domaines d\u2019investigation sont privil\u00e9gi\u00e9s : l\u2019industrie, la sant\u00e9 et l\u2019environnement. Le ou la candidate sera affil\u00e9\u00b7e au LEMNA (Laboratoire \u00c9conomie et Management Nantes Atlantique).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Plus pr\u00e9cis\u00e9ment, le poste sera rattach\u00e9 \u00e0 la <a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.imt-atlantique.fr\/fr\/recherche-innovation\/collaborer\/chaires\/resoh\">chaire RESOH<\/a> [Recherche en S\u00e9curit\u00e9 Organisations Hommes]. Les travaux de recherche, \u00e0 l\u2019interface de la sociologie et de la gestion, portent sur le fonctionnement des organisations \u00e0 hauts risques. Partant de l\u2019analyse du travail et des organisations de travail, il s\u2019agit d\u2019\u00e9clairer les dimensions socio-organisationnelles, manag\u00e9riales et institutionnelles contribuant \u00e0 (ou emp\u00eachant) le maintien d\u2019un niveau de fiabilit\u00e9 compatible avec les exigences de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et de production. Les recherches de la chaire sont conduites en \u00e9troite collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et institutionnels. Elles visent \u00e0 produire des connaissances scientifiques fond\u00e9es sur des enqu\u00eates de terrain, mais \u00e9galement \u00e0 favoriser leur mise en discussion, leur appropriation et leur mobilisation par les acteurs concern\u00e9s. Dans ce contexte, la chaire souhaite renforcer ses capacit\u00e9s de valorisation, de diffusion et d\u2019appropriation de ses travaux, aupr\u00e8s de ses partenaires actuels comme, plus largement, du monde socio-\u00e9conomique.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">&nbsp;<\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\"><strong><span style=\"color:#01B4D5\">2-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Les travaux de recherche, \u00e0 l\u2019interface de la sociologie et de la gestion, portent sur le fonctionnement des organisations \u00e0 hauts risques. Partant de l\u2019analyse du travail et des organisations de travail, il s\u2019agit d\u2019\u00e9clairer les dimensions socio-organisationnelles, manag\u00e9riales et institutionnelles contribuant \u00e0 (ou emp\u00eachant) le maintien d\u2019un niveau de fiabilit\u00e9 compatible avec les exigences de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et de production. Les recherches de la chaire sont conduites en \u00e9troite collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et institutionnels. concern\u00e9s.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\"><em>&nbsp;<\/em><\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\"><strong><span style=\"color:#01B4D5\">MISSIONS<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\">En Participer \u00e0 des activit\u00e9s annexes du projet EMPOWR<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Participe \u00e0 la r\u00e9daction des livrables<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Participe aux assembl\u00e9es g\u00e9n\u00e9rales du projet ainsi qu\u2019aux r\u00e9unions techniques<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">R\u00e9dige des publications scientifiques<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><h3><span style=\"color:#1999e3\">Le Projet<\/span><\/h3><p class=\"MsoNormal\">L\u2019objectif principal du projet <strong>EMPOWR<\/strong> est d\u2019introduire un \u00e9cosyst\u00e8me d\u2019augmentation multicouches qui transformera les espaces de travail industriels en environnements adaptatifs et intelligents, o\u00f9 les travailleurs ne seront plus simplement des op\u00e9rateurs, mais des d\u00e9cideurs am\u00e9lior\u00e9s. Cet \u00e9cosyst\u00e8me favorisera la collaboration homme-machine gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 deux technologies cl\u00e9s : un <strong>outil de r\u00e9alit\u00e9 augment\u00e9 adaptatif<\/strong>, accompagn\u00e9 d\u2019un <strong>compagnon IA cognitif<\/strong>, <em>Adaptive Learning Manufacturing Assistant<\/em><strong> (ALMA )<\/strong>, un syst\u00e8me d\u2019IA bas\u00e9 sur des mod\u00e8les de langage (LLM) qui jouera le r\u00f4le d\u2019intelligence de l\u2019espace de travail industriel.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><h3><span style=\"color:#1999e3\">L\u2019\u00e9quipe<\/span><\/h3><p class=\"MsoNormal\">L\u2019\u00e9quipe <strong>INUIT<\/strong> (Interaction Naturelle Immersive pour l\u2019Utilisateur) du d\u00e9partement Informatique m\u00e8ne des recherches sur l\u2019interaction en r\u00e9alit\u00e9 mixte en concevant des syst\u00e8mes de r\u00e9alit\u00e9 virtuelle et augment\u00e9e, en proposant des mod\u00e8les et des m\u00e9taphores \u00e9valu\u00e9s par des exp\u00e9riences utilisateurs. Les domaines d\u2019application incluent notamment l\u2019Industrie du Futur, la Sant\u00e9, la D\u00e9fense et le Patrimoine Culturel.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\">L\u2019\u00e9quipe <strong>INUIT<\/strong> est responsable de la conception et du d\u00e9veloppement de l\u2019outil de r\u00e9alit\u00e9 augment\u00e9e adaptatif. Ce dernier int\u00e9grera un espace de conception en r\u00e9alit\u00e9 augment\u00e9e con\u00e7u pour prendre en charge plusieurs formes d\u2019affichage d\u2019informations via des augmentations. L\u2019affichage s\u2019appuiera en pratique sur des \u00e9l\u00e9ments fournis par ALMA ainsi que sur des signaux physiologiques surveill\u00e9s chez les travailleurs. L\u2019outil de RA sera d\u00e9ploy\u00e9 dans deux cas d\u2019usage industriels, et des \u00e9tudes utilisateurs seront men\u00e9es pour validation.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\"
