b\u00e2ti face au changement climatique\"","description":"<p>Rejoindre <a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.mines-stetienne.fr\/\"><span style=\"color:#0563C1\">Mines Saint-\u00c9tienne<\/span><\/a>, c\u2019est s\u2019engager dans une institution o\u00f9 la <strong>science et l\u2019innovation b\u00e2tissent un avenir plus durable<\/strong>. Une \u00e9cole d\u2019excellence o\u00f9 chacun<strong>&nbsp;<\/strong>a<strong> l\u2019opportunit\u00e9 de r\u00e9v\u00e9ler son plein potentiel <\/strong>et de <strong>contribuer \u00e0 relever les d\u00e9fis de demain<\/strong>.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Class\u00e9e parmi les meilleures \u00e9coles d\u2019ing\u00e9nieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre \u00e9cole, membre de l\u2019Institut Mines-T\u00e9l\u00e9com, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement \u00e0 relever les grands d\u00e9fis industriels, num\u00e9riques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous int\u00e9grez une communaut\u00e9 de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 \u00e9tudiants, et participez \u00e0 un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence acad\u00e9mique, recherche d\u2019avant-garde et impact soci\u00e9tal positif.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=m39m6hdNC48\"><span style=\"color:#0563C1\">L\u2019Institut Mines-T\u00e9l\u00e9com<\/span><\/a> f\u00e9d\u00e8re les grandes \u00e9coles fran\u00e7aises autour des d\u00e9fis industriels majeurs, num\u00e9riques, \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques et \u00e9cologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes \u00c9coles publiques et 2 \u00e9coles filiales, il est le premier institut public d\u00e9di\u00e9 aux ing\u00e9nieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui fa\u00e7onneront les transitions de demain.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong><em><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Transitions num\u00e9riques, \u00e9cologiques, industrielles : les grands d\u00e9fis de notre \u00e9poque sont aussi ceux de l\u2019Institut Henri Fayol.<\/span><\/em><\/strong><\/p><p><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Ici se m\u00ealent Informatique, Sciences des donn\u00e9es, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, G\u00e9nie environnemental pour penser les syst\u00e8mes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, fili\u00e8res industrielles.&nbsp;<\/span><\/p><p><span style=\"color:#000000\">\ud83d\udcca&nbsp;<\/span><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">R\u00e9silience, performance, durabilit\u00e9\u2026&nbsp;Nous d\u00e9veloppons et exp\u00e9rimentons en lien \u00e9troit avec les acteurs socio-\u00e9conomique pour r\u00e9pondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.<\/span><\/p><p><span style=\"color:#000000\">\u2728&nbsp;<\/span><span style=\"color:#0A121E\">Une recherche interdisciplinaire \u00e0 fort impact, o\u00f9 l\u2019humain est toujours au centre.<\/span><span style=\"color:#000000\">&nbsp;<\/span><\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>Cette th\u00e8se de doctorat sera rattach\u00e9e au d\u00e9partement G\u00e9nie de l'Environnement pour les Organisations (GEO), membre du Laboratoire CNRS UMR 5600 Environnement Ville et Soci\u00e9t\u00e9 (EVS). Pour r\u00e9pondre aux enjeux des transitions \u00e9cologique, \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et industrielle, le d\u00e9partement GEO accompagne les acteurs des territoires (acteurs publics et priv\u00e9s) vers une meilleure prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux et de r\u00e9silience territoriale. Il s'attache ainsi \u00e0 apporter des solutions nouvelles en mati\u00e8re d'analyse, de mod\u00e9lisation et d'\u00e9valuation environnementale des syst\u00e8mes industriels et territoriaux dans un double contexte d'industrie des futurs et de villes et territoires soutenables.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>\ud83c\udfe0 <strong><span style=\"font-size:1.2em\">Contexte <\/span><\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Pr\u00e9sentation du sujet<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Le changement climatique met en lumi\u00e8re, comme l'a fait auparavant la crise COVID, les vuln\u00e9rabilit\u00e9s et liens de d\u00e9pendance g\u00e9n\u00e9ralis\u00e9e de nos modes de vie envers les infrastructures, les cha\u00eenes de valeur, et modes d'organisation \u00e9conomique et technique, \u00e9l\u00e9ments souvent d\u00e9connect\u00e9s de l'usager final, de ses besoins et des conditions d'occupation. Pour le secteur du b\u00e2timent, Cimerman (2023) \u00e9voque une tendance depuis plusieurs d\u00e9cennies de \u00ab simplification cart\u00e9sienne \u00bb de la conception et de l'op\u00e9ration du b\u00e2ti. Celle-ci se traduit notamment par le d\u00e9veloppement d'un imaginaire de \u00ab b\u00e2timent-machine \u00bb, se traduisant par une superposition d'\u00e9l\u00e9ments techniques complexes (chauffage, ventilation, climatisation), susceptibles d'\u00eatre pilot\u00e9s au travers d'outils informatiques et d'une gestion centralis\u00e9e optimis\u00e9e (Cimerman, 2023).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Face aux enjeux pos\u00e9s par le changement climatique, deux voies oppos\u00e9es d'adaptation du b\u00e2ti se dessinent. La premi\u00e8re, actuellement dominante, consiste \u00e0 prolonger cet imaginaire de \u00ab b\u00e2timent-machine \u00bb, rationalisable, mesurable et optimisable, et ce notamment au travers du d\u00e9veloppement du \u00ab smart-building \u00bb. Cette approche technosolutionniste apporte des r\u00e9ponses cl\u00e9s-en-main (capteurs, outils de pilotage centralis\u00e9s, etc.) aux gestionnaires et usagers de b\u00e2timents. N\u00e9anmoins, elle pr\u00e9sente certains d\u00e9fis pour leur maintenance et leur entretien. Nous pouvons citer le recours massif aux nouvelles technologies, co\u00fbteuses, complexes, rapidement obsol\u00e8tes et dont la fabrication repose en grande partie sur des ressources finies. Cela pose de plus les questions centrales des comp\u00e9tences, de la d\u00e9l\u00e9gation du savoir et des outils associ\u00e9s \u00e0 des op\u00e9rateurs experts externes.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">En contrepoint \u00e0 la premi\u00e8re voie, une seconde approche, encore marginale, \u00e9merge : celle d'un \u00ab b\u00e2timent low-tech \u00bb. Popularis\u00e9e ces derni\u00e8res ann\u00e9es en France par Philippe Bihouix (Bihouix, 2014), la low-tech questionne le rapport \u00e0 la technologie et aux diff\u00e9rentes formes de d\u00e9pendances qu'elle g\u00e9n\u00e8re (Tanguy et al., 2023). Dans le secteur du b\u00e2timent, l'application de cette d\u00e9marche renvoie souvent \u00e0 la d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 la ressource (\u00e9nergie et mati\u00e8re) : repenser les usages, l'origine des mat\u00e9riaux (r\u00e9employ\u00e9s, biosourc\u00e9s) ou encore la simplicit\u00e9 de l'\u00e9quipement utilis\u00e9. Bien que n\u00e9cessaires, ces travaux s'int\u00e9ressent pourtant peu \u00e0 d'autres formes de d\u00e9pendances associ\u00e9es \u00e0 la technique, au titre desquelles nous pouvons citer la d\u00e9pendance aux savoirs et aux formes d'organisation sociale et \u00e9conomique qui conditionnent l'ad\u00e9quation, la p\u00e9rennit\u00e9 et l'efficacit\u00e9 des solutions propos\u00e9es.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Cette th\u00e8se offre ainsi une immersion concr\u00e8te dans les questions d'adaptation du parc b\u00e2ti au changement climatique par la \u00ab&nbsp;lowtech&nbsp;\u00bb \u00e0 l'interface entre sciences de l'ing\u00e9nieur et sciences humaines et sociales. Les comp\u00e9tences et l'exp\u00e9rience acquises trouveront une r\u00e9sonance particuli\u00e8re dans un secteur en pleine mutation, o\u00f9 la ma\u00eetrise des d\u00e9pendances techniques, \u00e9conomiques et organisationnelles devient un enjeu central pour la soutenabilit\u00e9 des b\u00e2timents et de leur exploitation.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Contexte scientifique<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">La litt\u00e9rature consacr\u00e9e \u00e0 la low-tech s'est structur\u00e9e ces derni\u00e8res ann\u00e9es autour d'une critique de la fuite en avant technologique et des d\u00e9pendances qu'elle engendre (Bihouix, 2014 ; Tanguy et al., 2023). Appliqu\u00e9e au b\u00e2timent, cette litt\u00e9rature reste toutefois majoritairement centr\u00e9e sur la phase de conception et sur la d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 la ressource : sobri\u00e9t\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique, choix de mat\u00e9riaux biosourc\u00e9s ou r\u00e9employ\u00e9s, r\u00e9duction du niveau d'\u00e9quipement technique.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Deux angles morts en d\u00e9coulent. Le premier concerne la phase d'exploitation : la maintenance et l'entretien, qui repr\u00e9sentent pourtant l'essentiel de la dur\u00e9e de vie d'un b\u00e2timent et conditionnent la performance r\u00e9elle des solutions install\u00e9es, sont peu trait\u00e9s comme objet de recherche \u00e0 part enti\u00e8re. Le second concerne la nature m\u00eame des d\u00e9pendances \u00e9tudi\u00e9es. Au-del\u00e0 de la ressource, la conduite d'une op\u00e9ration de maintenance mobilise des savoirs et savoir-faire, des outils de diagnostic, des pi\u00e8ces d\u00e9tach\u00e9es, des prestataires et des cha\u00eenes d'approvisionnement, ainsi que des cadres contractuels et r\u00e9glementaires. Ces d\u00e9pendances d\u2019ordres cognitives, organisationnelles, \u00e9conomiques restent largement implicites et sous d\u00e9velopp\u00e9es dans les travaux existants.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">La caract\u00e9risation de ces d\u00e9pendances soul\u00e8ve par ailleurs une question d'\u00e9chelle. Analys\u00e9e au seul niveau du b\u00e2timent, la maintenance appara\u00eet comme une somme d'op\u00e9rations techniques ; replac\u00e9e \u00e0 l'\u00e9chelle urbaine, elle r\u00e9v\u00e8le des r\u00e9seaux d'acteurs, des fili\u00e8res, des comp\u00e9tences localement disponibles ou absentes, et des effets de d\u00e9pendance mutualis\u00e9s.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Contexte op\u00e9rationnel<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Du c\u00f4t\u00e9 des acteurs institutionnels et \u00e9conomiques, de nombreux outils accompagnent aujourd'hui la gestion technique du patrimoine b\u00e2ti. Nous pouvons citer :<\/p><ul><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">les outils de gestion de maintenance assist\u00e9e par ordinateur (GMAO) et les plateformes de gestion technique du b\u00e2timent (GTB) ;<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">les d\u00e9marches de mod\u00e9lisation des donn\u00e9es du b\u00e2timent (BIM d'exploitation, jumeaux num\u00e9riques) et les labels associ\u00e9s \u00e0 la connectivit\u00e9 des b\u00e2timents ;<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">les contrats d'exploitation et de maintenance externalis\u00e9s, et les dispositifs de garantie de performance \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique ;<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">les d\u00e9marches et retours d'exp\u00e9rience issus de la mouvance low-tech (chantiers d\u00e9monstrateurs, guides praticiens, r\u00e9seaux associatifs).<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Ces dispositifs partagent une orientation commune : ils visent \u00e0 optimiser la conduite de la maintenance, rarement \u00e0 interroger les d\u00e9pendances qu'elle installe. Les d\u00e9marches low-tech, \u00e0 l'inverse, portent cette interrogation mais restent au stade de l'exp\u00e9rimentation ponctuelle, sans cadre d'\u00e9valuation partag\u00e9 ni capacit\u00e9 de g\u00e9n\u00e9ralisation \u00e0 l'\u00e9chelle d'un parc ou d'un territoire.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Il en r\u00e9sulte, en l'\u00e9tat des connaissances aussi bien scientifiques qu'op\u00e9rationnelles, qu'il n'existe pas de m\u00e9thode permettant de rendre visibles et de qualifier les d\u00e9pendances associ\u00e9es \u00e0 la maintenance et \u00e0 l'entretien des b\u00e2timents, ni d'\u00e9valuer dans quelle mesure une approche low-tech permettrait de les r\u00e9duire.<\/p><p><br>\ud83c\udfaf&nbsp;<strong><span style=\"font-size:1.2em\">Ce que nous attendons de vous<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>D\u00e9marche de la th\u00e8se<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">L'objectif principal de cette th\u00e8se est de caract\u00e9riser les apports d'une approche low-tech pour cartographier et ma\u00eetriser, sinon r\u00e9duire, les diff\u00e9rentes formes de d\u00e9pendances associ\u00e9es \u00e0 la maintenance et \u00e0 l'entretien des b\u00e2timents.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Les d\u00e9pendances analys\u00e9es s'appuieront sur les techniques, pratiques, outils et r\u00e9seaux en lien avec la maintenance qui seront mis en \u00e9vidence dans les deux autres th\u00e8ses du projet <strong>PERENNIS<\/strong>. Cette th\u00e8se s'inscrit donc en compl\u00e8te continuit\u00e9 de ces deux travaux.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Dans un premier temps, il s'agira de construire un cadre d'analyse des d\u00e9pendances li\u00e9es \u00e0 la maintenance du b\u00e2timent, articulant quatre registres : les ressources (\u00e9nergie, mati\u00e8re, pi\u00e8ces d\u00e9tach\u00e9es), les savoirs et savoir-faire, les acteurs et leurs relations contractuelles, et les r\u00e9seaux techniques et logistiques. Cette phase s'appuiera sur une revue de la litt\u00e9rature scientifique et \u00ab grise \u00bb, sur un benchmark des pratiques et outils de maintenance existants, et sur des entretiens avec les acteurs du secteur (gestionnaires de patrimoine, bailleurs, mainteneurs, bureaux d'\u00e9tudes, collectivit\u00e9s).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Dans un deuxi\u00e8me temps, ce cadre sera mobilis\u00e9 pour caract\u00e9riser et rendre visibles les sch\u00e9mas de d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 l'\u00e9chelle urbaine, sur un ou plusieurs territoires d'\u00e9tude. Il s'agira notamment d'identifier les sources de donn\u00e9es mobilisables pour objectiver ces sch\u00e9mas, de qualifier les points de fragilit\u00e9 et d'appr\u00e9cier leur variabilit\u00e9 selon les typologies de b\u00e2timents et les configurations d'acteurs.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Dans un troisi\u00e8me temps, des strat\u00e9gies prospectives low-tech de maintenance et d'entretien seront propos\u00e9es et instruites. Il s'agira de construire des sc\u00e9narios contrast\u00e9s, d'\u00e9valuer leur capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 r\u00e9duire la vuln\u00e9rabilit\u00e9 technique, \u00e9conomique et sociale des op\u00e9rations de maintenance dans un contexte d'adaptation au changement climatique, et d'en discuter la faisabilit\u00e9 et l'acceptabilit\u00e9 avec les parties prenantes concern\u00e9es.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Verrous scientifiques :<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p>D\u00e9finition et op\u00e9rationnalisation de la notion de d\u00e9pendance appliqu\u00e9e \u00e0 la maintenance du b\u00e2ti, au-del\u00e0 de la seule d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 la ressource (savoirs, acteurs, organisations, r\u00e9seaux)<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Caract\u00e9risation et repr\u00e9sentation de sch\u00e9mas de d\u00e9pendance \u00e0 l'\u00e9chelle urbaine, \u00e0 partir de donn\u00e9es h\u00e9t\u00e9rog\u00e8nes et partiellement indisponibles<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">\u00c9valuation prospective de strat\u00e9gies low-tech en l'absence de retours d'exp\u00e9rience consolid\u00e9s et de m\u00e9triques \u00e9tablies<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Articulation interdisciplinaire entre sciences de l'ing\u00e9nieur et sciences humaines et sociales, et capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 r\u00e9pliquer l'approche tout en visant la \u00ab parcimonie \u00bb des m\u00e9thodes et mod\u00e8les<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Objectifs de d\u00e9veloppement durable rattach\u00e9s :<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">ODD 11 \u2013 Villes et communaut\u00e9s durables \u00b7<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">ODD 12 \u2013 Consommation et production responsables<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">ODD 13 \u2013 Mesures relatives \u00e0 la lutte contre les changements climatiques.<\/p><figure><img style=\"width:408px\" src=\"https:\/\/recruitee-main.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com\/uploads\/bamvhl2ynlf2u26pdlba5e7ec83o17\/doctorat.png\"><\/figure> <br> <p>\ud83d\udd0d <strong><span style=\"font-size:1.2em\">Ce que nous recherchons<\/span><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Formation<\/strong> : Bac +5 en ing\u00e9nierie g\u00e9n\u00e9raliste, sciences de l'environnement, g\u00e9nie civil ou \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique du b\u00e2timent, g\u00e9ographie\/am\u00e9nagement, ou discipline connexe. Une formation ou une sensibilit\u00e9 aux sciences humaines et sociales (sociologie des techniques, STS, \u00e9conomie de la fonctionnalit\u00e9) serait un plus.<\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Comp\u00e9tences requises<\/strong> :<\/p><ul><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>M\u00e9thodes qualitatives<\/u> : conduite et analyse d'entretiens semi-directifs, observation de terrain, analyse de corpus documentaires.<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>Analyse syst\u00e9mique et prospective<\/u> : capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 repr\u00e9senter un syst\u00e8me sociotechnique, \u00e0 construire et instruire des sc\u00e9narios.<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>Connaissance du b\u00e2timent<\/u> : compr\u00e9hension du fonctionnement technique du b\u00e2ti et de ses \u00e9quipements, et des logiques d'exploitation et de maintenance.<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>Traitement de donn\u00e9es<\/u> : aisance avec des donn\u00e9es h\u00e9t\u00e9rog\u00e8nes issues de sources vari\u00e9es ; la ma\u00eetrise d'outils de traitement (R, Python) ou de SIG (QGIS) serait appr\u00e9ci\u00e9e.<\/p><\/li><li><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u>Gestion de projets<\/u> : aptitude \u00e0 structurer et mener des phases de projet de mani\u00e8re autonome, en articulation avec deux autres doctorants du projet.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Langue<\/strong> : fran\u00e7ais courant et anglais op\u00e9rationnel (capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 lire des publications techniques et scientifiques en anglais).<\/p><p class=\"MsoListParagraph\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Profil recherch\u00e9<\/strong> : individus responsables, proactifs, et dot\u00e9s d'un esprit analytique, capables de faire preuve de rigueur scientifique. Personnes dynamiques, motiv\u00e9es par les enjeux environnementaux et par le questionnement critique de la technique. Capacit\u00e9 d'adaptation, go\u00fbt pour le travail interdisciplinaire et collaboratif avec des acteurs vari\u00e9s.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>\ud83d\udce9 <strong><span That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325\u2013580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix\u2013vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix\u2013vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply\u2013accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. The quantisation literature for diffusion models reports image-quality scores; the induced L 2 score error, in the form the convergence theory needs, is directly measurable and goes unreported. One open sub-question sets the direction: the distinction between an error redrawn at each evaluation, as in stochastic computing, and an error frozen at write time, as in deterministic quantisation, has been settled in one setting only, and not the one hardware lives in; carrying it over is what this position exists to do. The work is judged on one concrete outcome. For at least one architecture, we want to show that theenergy gain from moving the score evaluation off digital CMOS is real, measured where it survives integration and not extrapolated from a single tile, and that it is paid for by a loss in sample quality that is small and, above all, tunable: a knob the designer sets, whose position the theory predicts rather than discovers afterwards. <\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>What you will do<\/strong> <\/p><p>The work is organised in four packages, summarised below; the full research programme is available from the supervisors on request. <\/p><p>1. Make the score error measurable, starting from Gaussian targets where the whole error decomposition is closed-form. You will report the induced score error for a given perturbation of the network\u2019s arithmetic, the number the theory needs and the quantisation literature does not report. <\/p><p>2. Map device physics onto the theory. Propagate the published error models for the technologies INL works on through the score network into an explicit score-error budget, separating what is proved from what is measured. <\/p><p>3. Extend the guarantees. Existing bounds assume a deterministic oracle, or a benign randomised one; extend them to error that is part frozen at write time and part redrawn at each call, and settle, on the way, which process the score error should be controlled along. <\/p><p>4. Co-design with INL, and deliver the proof of concept. Turn the score-error budget into an energy\u2013 accuracy frontier for INL\u2019s PCM-based photonic matrix\u2013vector engine, using device-calibrated circuitlevel models; a FeFET-based analog alternative may be considered where appropriate. Jointly vary sampler steps, stochastic bitstream length and effective precision to identify an operating point predicted to yield a real energy advantage over digital CMOS at a small, tunable loss in sample quality. The result is a frontier predicted from mathematical and hardware models, then verified against calibrated measurements. <\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p>A clear negative answer is more useful to us than a vague positive one: a negative result on point 3 leaves points 1 and 2 intact and turns point 4 from a prediction into a measurement.<\/p> <br> <p><strong>Who we are looking for Required<\/strong> <\/p><p>\u2022 A PhD in applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, electronic engineering, computer science or a closely related field, obtained (or with the defence scheduled) before the start of the contract. <\/p><p>\u2022 A strong foundation in probability and stochastic analysis, numerical analysis, optimisation, or machine learning: SDEs, Girsanov\u2019s theorem, time reversal of diffusions, with the ability to apply it rigorously to diffusion or other generative models. <\/p><p>\u2022 Familiarity with the convergence theory of sampling algorithms, or the demonstrated capacity to acquire it quickly, for example through Langevin\/MCMC analysis, optimal transport or concentration of measure. <\/p><p>\u2022 Solid scientific computing (PyTorch or JAX), and the habit of writing code others can run. Ability and motivation to work across mathematical modelling and hardware-aware AI. <\/p><p>\u2022 Working English; French is not required. <\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>Valued, not required<\/strong> <\/p><p>Prior work on diffusion or score-based generative models; numerical analysis of finite-precision arithmetic. Familiarity with hardware-aware machine learning, approximate or stochastic computing, analogue in-memory computing, device modelling, circuit simulation, photonics, ferroelectric devices, or energy modelling. Experience linking model accuracy or robustness to implementation non-idealities, such as quantisation, noise, drift, variability, finite precision, or correlated errors. Evidence of interdisciplinary research, for example work at the interface of mathematics, machine learning, devices, circuits, architectures, or electronic-design automation. No hardware experience is expected or needed to apply.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>What matters most<\/strong> <\/p><p>We are seeking a researcher who wants to explore how to turn physical constraints into mathematical and architectural design parameters. The project does not require prior laboratory hardware experience: INL provides device expertise, measured characteristics and modelling infrastructure. However, the successful candidate must be prepared to engage critically with non-ideal analog, photonic and ferroelectric accelerators, and to work with both supervisors to connect device-level error mechanisms, score-error guarantees and the energy\u2013quality trade-off of diffusion-model inference. Candidates with a primarily mathematical background and strong curiosity for hardware are welcome, as are candidates from AIhardware, device-modeling, circuit, architecture or EDA backgrounds who have the stochastic-analysis maturity needed to develop the theory. The decisive criterion is the ability to make the mathematics and hardware inform one another, producing predictions that are quantitative, testable and relevant to an energy-efficient accelerator demonstrator.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>What we offer<\/strong> <\/p><p>\u2022 A real double supervision, with weekly meetings that alternate between ICJ and INL. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data \u2014 securing and protecting private information more effectively \u2014 Elastic\u2019s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;What is the role&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principal software engineering role that focuses on enhancing the vector similarity search functionality within Elasticsearch, covering the design and implementation of new vector search features, enhancements to existing vector search functionality, and resolving bugs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Will Be Doing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead initiatives within &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/github.com\/elastic\/elasticsearch\/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Elasticsearch&lt;\/a&gt; to produce an industry-leading vector database offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to Elasticsearch full time, building new search features and fixing intriguing bugs, all while making the code easier to understand. Sometimes you&#39;ll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. Sometimes you&#39;ll need to get close to the operating system and hardware.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the vector search capabilities of Elasticsearch.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be an expert on how Elasticsearch implements vector similarity in support of search relevance and everyone will turn to you when they have a question about this area. You&#39;ll improve this area based on your questions and your instincts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with community members from all over the world on issues and pull requests, sometimes triaging them and handing them off to other experts and sometimes handling them yourself.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Bring Along&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have implemented novel techniques in vector similarity on a search platform with a large user base or progressed the field of academic research in vector similarity information retrieval.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Professional experience with vector similarity and vector databases, and you used HNSW, IVF, or other relevant algorithms and libraries on search platforms at scale.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as other features like lambdas.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You work with a high level of autonomy, and are able to take on projects and guide them from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with other engineers to develop needed components.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;re comfortable developing collaboratively. Giving and receiving feedback on code and approaches and APIs is hard! Bonus points if you&#39;ve collaborated over the internet because that&#39;s harder. Double bonus points for asynchronous collaboration over the internet. That&#39;s even harder, but we do it anyway because it&#39;s the best way we know how to build software.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve used several data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have excellent verbal and written communication skills. Like we said, collaborating on the internet is hard. We try to be respectful, empathetic, and trusting in all of our interactions. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch\u2019s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Will Be Doing:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a full-time Elasticsearch contributor, you will define, lead, and contribute to the evolution of core search and indexing capabilities. You\u2019ll research advances in search infrastructure, data structures, and retrieval algorithms to ensure we\u2019re building the most efficient and powerful foundations for our users. You\u2019ll work closely with our partners and product teams to understand their needs and help shape the long-term technical vision for search at Elastic. You\u2019ll bring your past experience with large-scale search systems to drive an innovative roadmap for Elasticsearch\u2019s indexing, query execution, and relevance layers. As an authority in several areas of Elasticsearch, you\u2019ll be the go-to expert for those domains, continuously improving them through your insights and instincts.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 12pt;&quot;&gt;What You Will Bring:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience leading technical projects in the search infrastructure and distributed systems space. You have a strong desire to optimize and leverage the most efficient algorithms and search data structures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Able to work with a high level of autonomy, tackling projects and guiding them from concept to completion, including both technical design and collaboration with other engineers to develop the necessary components.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with large-scale data or search systems such as Elasticsearch, Lucene, Solr, or distributed storage engines, and an understanding of how they work and why they work that way.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot;&gt;Excellent verbal and written communication skills. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data \u2014 securing and protecting private information more effectively \u2014 Elastic\u2019s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;What is the role&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principal software engineering role that focuses on enhancing the vector similarity search functionality within Elasticsearch, covering the design and implementation of new vector search features, enhancements to existing vector search functionality, and resolving bugs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Will Be Doing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead initiatives within &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/github.com\/elastic\/elasticsearch\/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Elasticsearch&lt;\/a&gt; to produce an industry-leading vector database offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to Elasticsearch full time, building new search features and fixing intriguing bugs, all while making the code easier to understand. Sometimes you&#39;ll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. Sometimes you&#39;ll need to get close to the operating system and hardware.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the vector search capabilities of Elasticsearch.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be an expert on how Elasticsearch implements vector similarity in support of search relevance and everyone will turn to you when they have a question about this area. You&#39;ll improve this area based on your questions and your instincts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with community members from all over the world on issues and pull requests, sometimes triaging them and handing them off to other experts and sometimes handling them yourself.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Bring Along&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Professional experience with vector similarity and vector databases, and you used HNSW, IVF, or other relevant algorithms and libraries on search platforms at scale.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as other features like lambdas.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You work with a high level of autonomy, and are able to take on projects and guide them from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with other engineers to develop needed components.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;re comfortable developing collaboratively. Giving and receiving feedback on code and approaches and APIs is hard! Bonus points if you&#39;ve collaborated over the internet because that&#39;s harder. Double bonus points for asynchronous collaboration over the internet. That&#39;s even harder, but we do it anyway because it&#39;s the best way we know how to build software.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve used several data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have excellent verbal and written communication skills. Like we said, collaborating on the internet is hard. We try to be respectful, empathetic, and trusting in all of our interactions. A consistent record of owning a product area with meaningful revenue impact and of leading products from strategy through shipped, iterated outcomes.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;37b8q&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;36va4-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;36va4-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;36va4-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Endpoint Detection and Response Domain Knowledge:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;36va4-0-1&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt; Hands-on knowledge of XDR, EDR, SIEM, or broader security operations, either as a product manager or as a practitioner such as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or incident responder. You can credibly discuss correlation, response automation, and detection engineering without a solutions engineer in the room. A practitioner background before transitioning into product is a solid plus and brings credibility that is hard to teach.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;37b8q&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;eqht5-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;eqht5-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;eqht5-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Exposure and Vulnerability Fluency:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;eqht5-0-1&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt; You understand the difference between raw scanning, asset inventory, and true exposure prioritization, and why exploitability and reachability beat CVSS severity. You do not need to run a scanner yourself, but you know what makes prioritization credible enough that a team acts on it.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;37b8q&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;38rae-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;38rae-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;38rae-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Analytics and Threat Understanding:&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;38rae-0-1&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt; A solid comprehension of the analytics and data science techniques behind detection and prioritization, and of the current cyber threat landscape these capabilities defend against. Solid understanding is required; hands-on modeling is not. Familiarity with AI security, how AI, ML, and agentic systems are attacked and defended, is a solid plus.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR&quot; The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data \u2014 securing and protecting private information more effectively \u2014 Elastic\u2019s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;ceh5j-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;ceh5j-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What is The Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;ceh5j-0-0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;p&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;6gic8&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;c98gl-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;c98gl-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;c98gl-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;We&#39;re looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security&#39;s most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;p&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;6gic8&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;9j17i-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;9j17i-0-0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;9j17i-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;9j17i-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security&#39;s product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;8liqe-0-0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;8liqe-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;8liqe-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Will Be Doing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-ul&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;7nvp4-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;6gic8&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;7nvp4-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;7nvp4-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;7nvp4-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in \u201cunder consideration.\u201d&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;6gic8&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;bp20o-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;bp20o-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;bp20o-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;6gic8&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;2d2a0-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;2d2a0-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;2d2a0-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Turn input from strategic accounts into successful products. Look for patterns across accounts. Shape some of these patterns into formal partnerships for design. You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities. You can work autonomously, drive decisions and result in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;6gic8&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;9acmo-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;9acmo-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;9acmo-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Communication Excellence: &lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;9acmo-0-1&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;You have impressive spoken and written communication skills. You can distill complex detection engineering and security operations concepts into clear narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive management.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;5f183-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;5f183-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Location and Travel&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;5f183-0-0&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;p&quot; data-block=&quot;true&quot; data-editor=&quot;6gic8&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;8n0pc-0-0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr&quot; data-offset-key=&quot;8n0pc-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-offset-key=&quot;8n0pc-0-0&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-text=&quot;true&quot;&gt;This role is remote-first. &lt;strong&gt;Travel up to 50% to support Elastic&#39;s most strategic accounts, including on-site executive and design-partner engagements, is expected.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you\u2019re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn\u2019t matter if you\u2019re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Health coverage for you and your family in many locations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Generous number of vacation days each year&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals.
